Но… — Он замолчал и медленно огляделся, будто хотел где-нибудь наткнуться на дружелюбный взгляд, и остановился на старом джентльмене, и говорит: — А *вы* разве не думали, что ей понравится, если я её поцелую, сэр?", "— Да нет; я… я… ну, нет, кажется, не думал."]}, "source_rows": [{"id": "043-036-0060", "tag": "p", "text": "Then he looks on around the same way to me, and says:", "sha256": "eb2d718c23afc599d0c8b49e6a8e8da23e769ab248e4b8ae4b19467e76fa59f8", "source_location": "div.chapter[38]/*[60]", "source_html": "Then he looks on around the same way to me, and says:"}, {"id": "043-036-0061", "tag": "p", "text": "“Tom, didn’t you think Aunt Sally ’d open out her arms and say, ‘Sid Sawyer—’”", "sha256": "070e534c0aee9fc6e657302763e856af87c97c3b9c86c0883b3e3b4adbef6384", "source_location": "div.chapter[38]/*[61]", "source_html": "“Tom, didn’t you think Aunt Sally ’d open out her arms and say, ‘Sid Sawyer—’”"}, {"id": "043-036-0062", "tag": "p", "text": "“My land!” she says, breaking in and jumping for him, “you impudent young rascal, to fool a body so—” and was going to hug him, but he fended her off, and says:", "sha256": "acd1444a08cae4da9fc82503772fca37ef74af6c7f1afcfdeadfb182df4e31b3", "source_location": "div.chapter[38]/*[62]", "source_html": "“My land!” she says, breaking in and jumping for him, “you impudent young rascal, to fool a body so—” and was going to hug him, but he fended her off, and says:"}, {"id": "043-036-0063", "tag": "p", "text": "“No, not till you’ve asked me first.”", "sha256": "057424fe0e70c8e7a7024dead9ff378150779906b291653ea2c334f87dc6c87e", "source_location": "div.chapter[38]/*[63]", "source_html": "“No, not till you’ve asked me first.”"}, {"id": "043-036-0064", "tag": "p", "text": "So she didn’t lose no time, but asked him; and hugged him and kissed him over and over again, and then turned him over to the old man, and he took what was left. And after they got a little quiet again she says:"}, {"id": "043-036-0065", "tag": "p", "text": "“Why, dear me, I never see such a surprise. We warn’t looking for you at all, but only Tom. We warn’t looking for you at all, but only Tom. Sis never wrote to me about anybody coming but him.”"}, {"id": "043-036-0066", "tag": "p", "text": "“It’s because it warn’t intended for any of us to come but Tom,” he says; “but I begged and begged, and at the last minute she let me come, too; so, coming down the river, me and Tom thought it would be a first-rate surprise for him to come here to the house first, and for me to by-and-by tag along and drop in, and let on to be a stranger. But it was a mistake, Aunt Sally. This ain’t no healthy place for a stranger to come.”", "sha256": "77335482d791060b1406cdab68b270d98848f9f483b8eae7a6abf8bf6a198c64", "source_location": "div.chapter[38]/*[66]", "source_html": "“It’s because it warn’t intended for any of us to come but Tom,” he says; “but I begged and begged, and at the last minute she let me come, too; so, coming down the river, me and Tom thought it would be a first-rate surprise for him to come here to the house first, and for me to by-and-by tag along and drop in, and let on to be a stranger. Well, to think of that performance! I don’t deny it, I was most putrified with astonishment when you give me that smack.”", "sha256": "5acefc376a73c843de9350985d68c3626b1dfa4df260117f4da6ef4cdac0357d", "source_location": "div.chapter[38]/*[67]", "source_html": "“No—not impudent whelps, Sid. I don’t deny it, I was most putrified with astonishment when you give me that smack.”"}, {"id": "043-036-0068", "tag": "source_caption", "text": "A pretty long Blessing", "sha256": "2b37d5c102fa15dce2c021f7224931760dc631cb799eef54c91cfc4b6f9ada78", "source_location": "illustration-index/#c33-290", "image_id": "c33-290"}, {"id": "043-036-0069", "tag": "p", "text": "We had dinner out in that broad open passage betwixt the house and the kitchen; and there was things enough on that table for seven families—and all hot, too; none of your flabby, tough meat that’s laid in a cupboard in a damp cellar all night and tastes like a hunk of old cold cannibal in the morning. Uncle Silas he asked a pretty long blessing over it, but it was worth it; and it didn’t cool it a bit, neither, the way I’ve seen them kind of interruptions do lots of times. There was a considerable good deal of talk all the afternoon, and me and Tom was on the lookout all the time; but it warn’t no use, they didn’t happen to say nothing about any runaway nigger, and we was afraid to try to work up to it. But at supper, at night, one of the little boys says:", "sha256": "cfa120ffd7de7e8b3ff8f5e4707329fe62ba5ae42850ee20d4dbe3297955f878", "source_location": "div.chapter[38]/*[69]", "source_html": "We had dinner out in that broad open passage betwixt the house and the kitchen; and there was things enough on that table for seven families—and all hot, too; none of your flabby, tough meat that’s laid in a cupboard in a damp cellar all night and tastes like a hunk of old cold cannibal in the morning. But at supper, at night, one of the little boys says:"}, {"id": "043-036-0070", "tag": "p", "text": "“Pa, mayn’t Tom and Sid and me go to the show?”", "sha256": "26ab39c13e7c2fd34e237133684796d16836c35eba2798eb6d362dd8739eef0e", "source_location": "div.chapter[38]/*[70]", "source_html": "“Pa, mayn’t Tom and Sid and me go to the show?”"}, {"id": "043-036-0071", "tag": "p", "text": "“No,” says the old man, “I reckon there ain’t going to be any; and you couldn’t go if there was; because the runaway nigger told Burton and me all about that scandalous show, and Burton said he would tell the people; so I reckon they’ve drove the owdacious loafers out of town before this time.”", "sha256": "61fa2407d0e2de3b1d9c51693117d59dec8a3faef9e3b1667731ca567ae7e856", "source_location": "div.chapter[38]/*[71]", "source_html": "“No,” says the old man, “I reckon there ain’t going to be any; and you couldn’t go if there was; because the runaway nigger told Burton and me all about that scandalous show, and Burton said he would tell the people; so I reckon they’ve drove the owdacious loafers out of town before this time.”"}, {"id": "043-036-0072", "tag": "p", "text": "So there it was!—but I couldn’t help it. Tom and me was to sleep in the same room and bed; so, being tired, we bid good-night and went up to bed right after supper, and clumb out of the window and down the lightning-rod, and shoved for the town; for I didn’t believe anybody was going to give the king and the duke a hint, and so if I didn’t hurry up and give them one they’d get into trouble sure.", "sha256": "678535ccb3d584aa8c0de3f5fa64d7eebb311a3d11d6b5d69ed6ea0b957c8a94", "source_location": "div.chapter[38]/*[72]", "source_html": "So there it was!—but I couldn’t help it. Tom and me was to sleep in the same room and bed; so, being tired, we bid good-night and went up to bed right after supper, and clumb out of the window and down the lightning-rod, and shoved for the town; for I didn’t believe anybody was going to give the king and the duke a hint, and so if I didn’t hurry up and give them one they’d get into trouble sure."}, {"id": "043-036-0073", "tag": "p", "text": "On the road Tom he told me all about how it was reckoned I was murdered, and how pap disappeared pretty soon, and didn’t come back no more, and what a stir there was when Jim run away; and I told Tom all about our Royal Nonesuch rapscallions, and as much of the raft voyage as I had time to; and as we struck into the town and up through the middle of it—it was as much as half-after eight, then—here comes a raging rush of people with torches, and an awful whooping and yelling, and banging tin pans and blowing horns; and we jumped to one side to let them go by; and as they went by I see they had the king and the duke astraddle of a rail—that is, I knowed it was the king and the duke, though they was all over tar and feathers, and didn’t look like nothing in the world that was human—just looked like a couple of monstrous big soldier-plumes. Well, it made me sick to see it; and I was sorry for them poor pitiful rascals, it seemed like I couldn’t ever feel any hardness against them any more in the world. It was a dreadful thing to see. Human beings can be awful cruel to one another.", "sha256": "be1d191c977b4cccaaf7c08b8ea362f3fcf7571db1f5c92b85a86bf79e26adbd", "source_location": "div.chapter[38]/*[73]", "source_html": "On the road Tom he told me all about how it was reckoned I was murdered, and how pap disappeared pretty soon, and didn’t come back no more, and what a stir there was when Jim run away; and I told Tom all about our Royal Nonesuch rapscallions, and as much of the raft voyage as I had time to; and as we struck into the town and up through the middle of it—it was as much as half-after eight, then—here comes a raging rush of people with torches, and an awful whooping and yelling, and banging tin pans and blowing horns; and we jumped to one side to let them go by; and as they went by I see they had the king and the duke astraddle of a rail—that is, I knowed it was the king and the duke, though they was all over tar and feathers, and didn’t look like nothing in the world that was human—just looked like a couple of monstrous big soldier-plumes. We asked some stragglers about it, and they said everybody went to the show looking very innocent; and laid low and kept dark till the poor old king was in the middle of his cavortings on the stage; then somebody give a signal, and the house rose up and went for them."}, {"id": "043-036-0076", "tag": "p", "text": "So we poked along back home, and I warn’t feeling so brash as I was before, but kind of ornery, and humble, and to blame, somehow—though I hadn’t done nothing. If I had a yaller dog that didn’t know no more than a person’s conscience does I would pison him. It takes up more room than all the rest of a person’s insides, and yet ain’t no good, nohow. Tom Sawyer he says the same."}, {"id": "043-036-0077", "tag": "source_caption", "text": "Vittles", "sha256": "0a7fabaf3ca85d02cc810dc138bb53a9d5a97cf971370b633d380efeaa23a969", "source_location": "illustration-index/#c34-293", "image_id": "c34-293"}], "final_rows": [{"source_id": "043-036-0060", "target": "Потом он так же обводит взглядом всех и поворачивается ко мне и говорит:", "source_sha256": "eb2d718c23afc599d0c8b49e6a8e8da23e769ab248e4b8ae4b19467e76fa59f8", "target_id": "ru-043-036-0060", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "a303cdf8daf0051666876651d1de16da3226394584469d365603cc9426c07fb0"}, {"source_id": "043-036-0061", "target": "— Том, а *ты* разве не думал, что тётя Салли раскроет объятия и скажет: «Сид Сойер…»?", "source_sha256": "070e534c0aee9fc6e657302763e856af87c97c3b9c86c0883b3e3b4adbef6384", "target_id": "ru-043-036-0061", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "fd51f754c21c0074e937dd6e92873ca6389656dc05a69862a49aec019aa2ebf0"}, {"source_id": "043-036-0062", "target": "— Батюшки! — говорит она, перебивая его и бросаясь к нему. — Ах ты, наглый мальчишка, так одурачить человека!.. — и хотела его обнять, но он удержал её и говорит:", "source_sha256": "acd1444a08cae4da9fc82503772fca37ef74af6c7f1afcfdeadfb182df4e31b3", "target_id": "ru-043-036-0062", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "557be0f381276ffb7cc28edf1d523b8ff4220ed4157453b17030cf351a3afa19"}, {"source_id": "043-036-0063", "target": "— Нет, не раньше, чем вы сначала попросите.", "source_sha256": "057424fe0e70c8e7a7024dead9ff378150779906b291653ea2c334f87dc6c87e", "target_id": "ru-043-036-0063", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "5017aaa6127e15141d2c7b8a27d0da076e444e974c33bd2c30b11af2157badcf"}, {"source_id": "043-036-0064", "target": "Она не стала терять времени и попросила; и обнимала его, и целовала, снова и снова, а потом передала старику, и тот взял, что осталось. А когда они немного поутихли, она говорит:", "source_sha256": "4851ed0ccefe6cd08d73f2ba00a394533969fda6f0e6556c4693b798ca7a8075", "target_id": "ru-043-036-0064", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "7fef168ecd2eae923b1b3a8df6a5f8b1c5b8b64f0a77ac71e1071df33ccc7b3d"}, {"source_id": "043-036-0065", "target": "— Ну и ну, никогда не видела такого сюрприза. Мы совсем не ждали *тебя*, а только Тома. Сестра ни словом не писала мне, что приедет кто-то, кроме него.", "source_sha256": "9947493749bf2ae1895e63d9f65cb3952440360f371df32f8994a798337a0ebb", "target_id": "ru-043-036-0065", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "6a70edebf59e40955054ba030be2c65acf23e2f18c98f383ef8caaa3fa224e48"}, {"source_id": "043-036-0066", "target": "— Это потому, что приезжать должен был только Том, — говорит он, — а я просил и просил, и в последнюю минуту она и меня отпустила; вот мы с Томом, пока плыли по реке, и решили, что будет отличный сюрприз, если он сначала придёт в дом, а я потом потихоньку подтянусь, зайду и притворюсь чужим. Но это была ошибка, тётя Салли. Нездоровое это место для чужого человека.", "source_sha256": "77335482d791060b1406cdab68b270d98848f9f483b8eae7a6abf8bf6a198c64", "target_id": "ru-043-036-0066", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "4f8a57ae095925d2ca43ff08e0997ffadded56e64e83ed96f4dac9d473a4e70c"}, {"source_id": "043-036-0067", "target": "— Нет — не наглые щенки, Сид. Надо бы тебе надрать уши; я так не выходила из себя уж и не знаю с каких пор. Но мне всё равно, я не обижаюсь на слова — я готова вытерпеть тысячу таких шуток, лишь бы ты был здесь. Ну надо же, какое представление! Не стану отрицать, я чуть не окаменела от изумления, когда ты меня чмокнул.", "source_sha256": "5acefc376a73c843de9350985d68c3626b1dfa4df260117f4da6ef4cdac0357d", "target_id": "ru-043-036-0067", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "a24ef019e639d1261c67524ca8b701e0940b70e14887a6460cb3bf62183f79f2"}, {"source_id": "043-036-0068", "target": "Довольно длинное благословение", "source_sha256": "2b37d5c102fa15dce2c021f7224931760dc631cb799eef54c91cfc4b6f9ada78", "target_id": "ru-043-036-0068", "tag": "source_caption", "target_sha256": "388d1dcc559be1fc967c807899cc792c7bd61cd38ebba12ba257d57906af8789"}, {"source_id": "043-036-0069", "target": "Обедали мы на том широком открытом проходе между домом и кухней; на столе было всего столько, что хватило бы на семь семей — и всё горячее; не какое-нибудь вялое, жёсткое мясо, что всю ночь пролежало в шкафу в сыром погребе, а наутро на вкус как кусок старого холодного каннибала.
